title: Julius Nyerere's birth chart
metaDescription: Julius Nyerere's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 22.7° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 22.7° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 22.7° Aries. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 10.8° Aries, Venus holds 8.3° Taurus, Mars holds 21.9° Sagittarius — in the old shorthand, a mind that decides at speaking speed; taste for the substantial and the lasting; drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Venus a sixth of the circle apart from Pluto, 0.3° off exact. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Jupiter sextile Neptune at 0.3°, and the Sun trine Mars at 0.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Mercury opposes Jupiter while both square Pluto. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has four entries for this chart. The Sun in Aries at 22.7° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; the Moon in Scorpio at 13.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Taurus at 8.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Libra at 2.8° is in exaltation. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 fire, 3 water, 2 air, 1 earth; by modality, 5 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable. Jupiter, Saturn and Neptune were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.4° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 13.6°.
